controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Original radar reconstruction archived by NASA/JPL, at its published kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is source geometry, not a photographic surface or reflectance map. The 1997 optical analysis statistically prefers the northern spin solution used here: period 4.089 h and ecliptic pole (253°, 56°). The alternative southern solution, period 4.094 h and pole (242°, 7°), was not absolutely excluded. This is the archived JPL shape, not a newly fitted model. Lighting uses the selected pole and an arbitrary display phase.
controls.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows original model radius minus a 0.542238 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same radar reconstruction, not an independent topographic measurement. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
controls.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
